      "text": "\n\n\nIf you\u0027ve exited osu! and lost the in-game multiplayer chat tab, don\u0027t worry! There are a few different ways you can retrieve your qualifier lobby link:\n\n**1. The Tournament Spreadsheet or Discord (Easiest)**\nAlmost all osu! tournaments use a master Google Spreadsheet to track schedules and scores. \n* Check the **\"Qualifiers\"** or **\"Schedule\"** tab on the tournament\u0027s spreadsheet. Referees usually paste the MP link right next to your team\u0027s name or lobby number as soon as the lobby finishes.\n* Alternatively, check the tournament\u0027s Discord server. Referees often drop the MP links in channels like `#qualifier-results`, `#lobby-links`, or `#referee-logs`.\n\n**2. Your Local osu! Chat Logs**\nIf you have chat logging enabled in your osu! settings (which is turned on by default for many players), your PC saved the lobby chat.\n* Open your osu! installation folder (usually located at `C:\\Users\\YourUsername\\AppData\\Local\\osu!`).\n* Open the **`Chat`** folder.\n* Look for a text file named something like **`#mp_12345678.txt`** (sort by \"Date modified\" to find the most recent one).\n* The number in that file name is your match ID! Just copy the numbers and put them at the end of this URL: `https://osu.ppy.sh/mp/YOUR_MATCH_ID`\n\n**3. Check Your Browser History**\nIf you or the referee dropped the link in the chat during the lobby and you clicked it even once to look at the scores between maps, it will be saved in your web browser\u0027s history. Just open your browser history (Ctrl+H or Cmd+H) and search for `osu.ppy.sh/mp/` or `osu.ppy.sh/community/matches/`.\n\n**4. Ask Your Referee or Teammates**\nIf you still can\u0027t find it, the quickest way is to just DM the referee who hosted your lobby on Discord or in-game, or ask one of the other players/teammates who were in the same lobby as you.
